description: Floating-point stability of an expression over variable ranges — Evaluates a real-valued expression in binary64 (or binary32) on a deterministic grid over the caller's variable ranges and compares each point with a certified arbitrary-precision reference, reporting the decimal digits lost, the worst input, and overflow, underflow or NaN. Recognises and rewrites exp(x)-1, 1-cos(x), log(1+x), sqrt(a)-sqrt(b), a^2-b^2, the quadratic formula, sqrt(x^2+y^2) and log-

alternative.description: Optional algebraically equal expression to score on the same grid.

expression.description: Expression in the declared variables, e.g. 'exp(x) - 1'. Operators + - * / ^ (or **); functions sqrt exp expm1 log log1p log2 log10 sin cos tan atan sinh cosh tanh abs pow hypot min max; constants pi, e.

maxDigitsLost.description: Fail above this many lost digits. Default 4.

precision.description: Arithmetic of the code under test. Default binary64.

min.description: Smallest value the variable takes (finite binary64).

scale.description: Grid spacing. Default: log when 0 < min and max/min >= 1000, else linear (with probes near 0 when the range contains it).

name: float-stability
